extraFacts.fact: Corrugated metal hose terms: annular corrugation is a series of parallel rings (versus helical, a continuous spiral); braid is a woven wire sleeve that contains pressure; ISO 10380 covers corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies, with a safety factor of 4:1 on burst pressure as quoted in the listings; hoses are hydrotested at 1.5 times working pressure.
extraFacts.source: ISO 10380 (corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies); manufacturer listings

faqs.q: What is the Thorburn B95 hose used for?
faqs.a: The Thorburn B95 — Bronze Annular, Unbraided Inner Core is a Bronze annular corrugated metallic hose. Typical uses include copper / brass pipework retrofits, decorative architectural installations and instrument-line connectors. See the [exotic alloy hoses](/c/metallic-exotic-alloy-hoses).

faqs.q: What does the B95 code mean in the Thorburn B95 hose?
faqs.a: In this listing B95 is bronze unbraided annular inner core (galvanic compatible). Across the Thorburn codes in this family the pattern is visible in the titles: 95 is an unbraided core, 96 a single braid and 96Z a double braid in the same alloy, so the digits set the braid and the letters the alloy.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Thorburn B95 hose come in?
faqs.a: The Thorburn B95 hose is listed with a nominal ID range of DN 6 (1/4") to DN 200 (8"). Minimum bend radius is 25 / 125 mm minimum (static / dynamic) with the OEM figures; confirm the size on your request.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature can the Thorburn B95 hose take?
faqs.a: The Thorburn B95 hose has working pressure to 8 bar at the smallest bore; operating temperature -200°C to +250°C. Working pressure 8 bar (smallest bore, unbraided configuration) — derates with increasing diameter and temperature per the OEM datasheet. Burst pressure 32 bar minimum, safety factor 4:1 per ISO 10380. Operating temperature -200°C to +250°C continuous; intermittent excursions evaluated on request. Pressure falls as bore and temperature rise, so give the full duty.

faqs.q: What is the Thorburn B95 hose made of?
faqs.a: The Thorburn B95 hose has core material Bronze, braid Unbraided — N/A (Unbraided) and end fitting material Bronze or brass fittings (galvanic compatibility). Construction type: exotic Alloy Annular — Bronze unbraided annular inner core (galvanic compatible).

faqs.q: Which standards and certificates apply to the Thorburn B95 hose?
faqs.a: The Thorburn B95 hose lists several standards and certificates. Listed: ISO 10380:2012 (Corrugated Metal Hoses and Hose Assemblies); ASME B31.3 (Bronze); EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2 mill test reports on request. Certificates are supplied as listed; ask for the ones the project needs when you request a quotation.

faqs.q: What do I send to order the Thorburn B95 hose?
faqs.a: To order the Thorburn B95 hose, confirm (a) line working pressure and process medium (specify chemistry, temperature, and any concentration limits — exotic-alloy selection depends critically on the corrosion envelope). (b) operating temperature range, (c) bore size and overall length, (d) end fitting style and matching alloy preference (matched-alloy fittings are recommended for severe service; SS fittings reduce cost where corrosion permits), (e) braid count (drives pressure rating), (f) any required certifications. Indus quotes ex-OEM with mill test reports, alloy-specific certifications, and pre-shipment hydrotest certificates.

faqs.q: What bend radius and weight does the Thorburn B95 hose have?
faqs.a: The Thorburn B95 hose lists a minimum bend radius of 25 / 125 mm minimum and a weight of ~0.2 kg/m (size-dependent). Keep the bend radius above the minimum, and do not twist the hose in service.

faqs.q: Thorburn B95 hose: why Bronze over stainless steel?
faqs.a: Bronze (typically C46400 naval bronze or C92200 leaded tin bronze) provides galvanic compatibility with copper / brass pipework — preventing the bimetallic corrosion that occurs when stainless contacts copper in moist environments. Also used for instrumentation lines and decorative service.

faqs.a: The Thorburn B95 hose has several listed uses. Listed uses: copper / brass pipework retrofits; decorative architectural installations; instrument-line connectors; marine copper-plumbed systems.

faqs.a: The Thorburn B95 hose differs from the [Thorburn H95](/p/thorburn-h95-hastelloy-c276-annular-unbraided-inner-core) on pressure and construction. In detail: working pressure to 8 bar at the smallest bore; operating temperature -200°C to +250°C here against working pressure to 12 bar at the smallest bore; operating temperature -200°C to +675°C there; core material bronze here and hastelloy C276 on the other.
